# Plugin Catalog — Row Hierarchy (Hierarchy, Tree, GroupingRows)

> Plugin system (manager, lifecycle, `PluginDependency.provide`) → grid-plugins.md. ServerSide (feeds Tree/GroupingRows via `datasource:*`), Pivot, row-identity rule → grid-plugins-catalog-data.md. Treegrid ARIA conventions → a11y.md.
> Read order for "tree/group rows wrong": Hierarchy contract → the contributor's section → data-flow-traces.md (tree expand).

## Hierarchy (#504)

OWNS: the row model shared by contributors (`plugins/hierarchy/`): pre-order flatten, `#meta: WeakMap<row,{level,setSize,posInSet}>`, `.rows-body` `role` `grid`↔`treegrid`, per-row `aria-level/setsize/posinset`. HOOKS: afterRender + onScrollRender (rows found via `RowElementInternal.__rowDataRef`). No config, no processRows hook. CONTRACT (`HierarchyContributor`): `hierarchyStage` `'structure'` (Tree) runs before `'transform'` (GroupingRows) on every natural sibling list; `beginHierarchy(rows)→false` sits out; `processSiblings(nodes,{parent,parentKey,depth})`; `endHierarchy(rows, positionOf)→boolean` (`false` = shaped nothing this rebuild).

- DECIDED (#504): contributors KEEP `processRows` and forward to `hierarchy.process(rows, this)`; only the LAST contributor in processRows-priority order builds the model for all, earlier ones pass rows through. No hierarchy attached (mock-grid specs) → fallback `buildHierarchy(rows,[this])`. WHY: zero churn in ~94 `plugin.processRows()` spec call sites; hook position (10, after ServerSide) unchanged. Expansion state/events/API stay in each contributor (accordion, lazy load, pending expansion are their expertise). Tests: `hierarchy.spec.ts`, `hierarchy-integration.spec.ts`.
- INVARIANT: `HierarchyNode.shaped:true` = children are final (group members), NOT re-run through contributors; omitted = natural list (tree children) every contributor reshapes. Members keep Tree-assigned natural children.
- INVARIANT: depth is STRUCTURAL in combination (groupOn `context.depth`, `__groupDepth`, `GroupRowModelItem.depth`, accordion predicate, Tree `FlattenedTreeRow.depth` via `positionOf` in `endHierarchy`). Standalone values unchanged. Nested group keys = `${parentTreeKey}::${composite}`; root keys unchanged.
- INVARIANT: hard dep auto-attached via `PluginDependency.provide`. Tree↔GroupingRows incompatibility REMOVED. Treegrid ARIA (#264) moved here from Tree/GroupingRows: writes compare-before-write (`setAttrIfChanged`); onScrollRender also covers rows scrolled into view. `posInSet`/`setSize` are 1-based PER PARENT list.
- INVARIANT (perf): `buildHierarchy` appends into ONE `out` array — never return/spread child arrays (wide expanded nodes exceed the JS argument limit). Bench (pure Tree flatten): `tree-data.bench.ts`.
- INVARIANT (PR #506): `role=treegrid` + per-row positions ONLY while the model has hierarchy. All active contributors' `endHierarchy` → `false` (e.g. all-null `groupOn`) ⇒ `buildHierarchy` deletes the recorded meta ⇒ `#applyAria` sets `role=grid`. Rows WITHOUT meta get `aria-level/setsize/posinset` REMOVED (virtualized row elements are pooled). Tree on flat (non-tree) data ⇒ `grid`.
- INVARIANT: `buildHierarchy` is PUBLIC (`@since 3.9.0`) — contributors import it from the `../hierarchy` barrel, which `externalizeCore()` maps to `@toolbox-web/grid/plugins/hierarchy`, so whatever a dependent plugin imports from another plugin's barrel ships as public API (no `@internal` exports there).
- TENSION: Tree `getFlattenedRows()` holds tree rows only — index-aligned with `grid.rows` standalone, NOT when group rows interleave; Tree `afterRender`/`onKeyDown` therefore look rows up by identity. `datasource:viewport-mapping` uses `#rootOwners` (index-aligned with the FINAL row list; root = `meta.parentKey === null`, built in `endHierarchy`) via `mapViewportToRoots`. Aggregators over a group of tree rows see direct members, not leaves.

## Tree

OWNS: expanded keys, flattened rows, `rowKeyMap`, `#rowMeta` `WeakMap<row,FlattenedTreeRow>`, `#rowKeys` `WeakMap<row,string>`, animation state, `#loads: Map<key,{row,depth,controller}>` (in-flight child loads, both routes), `#loadedRows`/`#requestedRows` (`WeakSet<row>`). Contributor stage `structure`: sorts each sibling list, attaches expanded children.
HOOKS: processRows(10, forwards), processColumns, afterCellRender, afterRender, onCellClick, onHeaderClick, renderRow, getRowHeight, adjustVirtualStart.
QUERIES: `canMoveRow`, `datasource:viewport-mapping`, `datasource:sort-mode`, `sort:get-model`. EVENTS: `tree-expand`, `tree-load-start|end|error`. FIRES: `datasource:fetch-children`. LISTENS: `datasource:children|error` (filtered on `context.source === 'tree'`).

- DECIDED (#524): `beginHierarchy` sets `#levelSort = null` when `datasource:sort-mode` is `'server'` — roots keep `getRows({sortModel})` order and lazy children keep `getChildRows({sortModel})` arrival order (ServerSide's `fetchChildren` sends the same enrichment). Tree's own header sort still writes `grid._sortState` + broadcasts `sort-change`, which ServerSide turns into a refetch. `'local'`/no data source → level sort as before. Tests: `integration/tree-server-side-sorting.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (#527): "children loaded" is gated by row IDENTITY (`#loadedRows`), not key — a ServerSide refetch (server sort/filter, `refresh()`) or `grid.rows =` hands a NEW object for the same key with lazy `children: true`. `endHierarchy` queues every visible expanded node needing a fetch whose row is NOT in `#requestedRows`; `#queueReconcile` flushes in ONE microtask (side effects out of the render pipeline) → `requestLazyChildren` + `requestRender()`. Also covers `expand(key)` before the row exists. WHY: no ServerSide→Tree purge event needed; children come back in the new server order. RULED OUT: clearing `loadedKeys` on a ServerSide purge broadcast (misses `grid.rows =`/local `loadChildren`). Tests: `integration/tree-lazy-refetch.spec.ts`.
- INVARIANT (#527): `#requestedRows` = ONE automatic attempt per row object (marked even with no loader) — without it a failing fetch re-requests on every render. Manual toggle/expand ignores it (retry after error). A CANCELLED load moves its row from `#requestedRows` to `#cancelledRows` (PR #530): a restored row (A → B → A) must reload automatically, but a late response for it must still drop — so the `datasource:children` drop guard checks BOTH sets.
- DECIDED (#527 QA N3): a load is owned by its ROW object (`#loads.get(key).row`). `requestLazyChildren` for a different row under the same key SUPERSEDES at once: `#cancelLoad` aborts its controller (local `loadChildren` signal; ServerSide via `FetchChildrenQuery.signal` → `getChildRows({signal})`) and emits `tree-load-end {cancelled:true, childCount:0}` (`@since 3.9.2`). CONTRACT: every `tree-load-start` → exactly one end-or-error (detach is silent). RECONCILE (PR #530 review): `endHierarchy` → `#needsReconcile` flags any RENDERED node whose key has a load for a different row — cancel regardless of fetch eligibility (collapsed node, or replacement embeds children), flushed in the `#queueReconcile` microtask; else a late result mutates the replaced row and a restore exposes it. NOT rendered (under a collapsed ancestor / removed) → load kept. Flat replacement (data stops being a tree → `beginHierarchy` returns `false`, `endHierarchy` never runs): the inactive branch calls `#reconcileFlatRows` — cancel-only, read-only key lookup (no `#keyFor` caching). Guards: `__loading` placeholders never supersede (path key collides with ids); only the key's `rowKeyMap` owner acts (duplicate ids can't ping-pong). A `datasource:children` for a row Tree requested but no longer has a load for is DROPPED (never mutate the replaced row); unrequested broadcasts still merge. Spinner/`aria-busy` via `#isLoading(meta)` (row identity, not key). RULED OUT: `tree-load-error` + AbortError (fires consumers' error UI), new `tree-load-cancel` event (3-adapter surface, existing counters drift).
- DECIDED (v3.4.0, lazy loading): two routes, ServerSide wins. `requestLazyChildren` checks `datasource:is-active` **via `queryBoolean`** (#430 — raw `query()` returns a truthy `[]`). Else `TreeConfig.loadChildren` (Promise or `Subscribable`, per-request `AbortController`, aborted on `detach()`). `Subscribable` is **take-one** — `finish()` removes the controller `detach()` would abort; a `settled` flag covers synchronous emission. Ref: `TreePlugin.#loadChildrenLocally`, `tree-integration.spec.ts`.
- INVARIANT (#430): `detectTreeStructure(rows, childrenField, hasChildren)` MUST receive `config.hasChildren` (predicate-only lazy trees have no `children` field), else detection returns false. File: [tree-detect.ts](libs/grid/src/lib/plugins/tree/tree-detect.ts).
- INVARIANT: lazy children are signalled by a truthy non-array `childrenField` or a `TreeConfig.hasChildren` predicate; single-batch (no pagination). `#loadedRows` (NOT `row[childrenField].length`) gates re-fetch; fetched at most once per row object per attach, errors do NOT mark loaded. `datasource:error` MUST be handled — else the load stays in `#loads` forever and retries short-circuit.
- INVARIANT: loading UI reuses core `createDefaultSpinner('small')` (+ `.tree-loading` sizing in `@layer tbw-plugins`). `afterRender` sets AND removes `aria-busy` (explicit negative branch) — EXCEPT on `.tbw-row-loading` rows (ServerSide placeholder / `grid.setRowLoading()`), whose `aria-busy` the core row-loading state owns (PR #511). Tree owns `aria-expanded` / `aria-busy` / `.tbw-row-expanded` (unguarded writes — extend the guard before adding per-frame writes).
- INVARIANT (async rows): `processColumns` is a no-op while `flattenedRows` is empty, and a ROWS-only render never re-runs COLUMNS — so rows arriving asynchronously (`grid.rows = …` after `ready()`, or a ServerSide block) would leave the tree column undecorated. `beginHierarchy` (inactive branch) and `endHierarchy` call `#syncTreeColumn()`, which microtask-defers a `#treeColumnWrapped !== flattenedRows.length > 0` check and `requestColumnsRender()`s on mismatch.
- INVARIANT: `_schedulerMergeConfig` reseeds `#baseColumns` from `_columns`, so a plugin-installed renderer is **already baked in** by the time `processColumns` runs — columns handed to a plugin are NOT pristine. Core resolves `renderer || viewRenderer`; renderer decorators MUST wrap that selected renderer in `renderer` and actively restore the original property (dropping the cache leaks the wrapper, and re-wrapping nests it). Tree caches whether the original came from `renderer` or `viewRenderer` so restoration preserves precedence.

## GroupingRows

OWNS: grouped row model, expanded keys, animation state, `loadingGroups`, `groupRowsMap`, `#groupLoads: Map<key,AbortController>`, `#requestedKeys` (per definitions generation). Contributor stage `transform`: groups each natural sibling list (`groupOn(row, {parent, depth})`; all-null list = ungrouped). HOOKS: processRows(10, forwards), onHeaderClick(-1), renderRow. QUERIES: `canMoveRow`, `grouping:get-grouped-fields`, `datasource:viewport-mapping`. EVENTS: `group-toggle|expand|collapse|load-error`. FIRES: `datasource:fetch-children` (pre-defined mode). LISTENS: `datasource:data|children|error`.

- DECIDED (#531): server child loads mirror Tree. `datasource:error` (`source:'grouping-rows'`, key in `#groupLoads`) → release `loadingGroups` + `emit('group-load-error', {groupKey,groupPath,error})`; re-expand retries (no `groupRowsMap` entry). `#groupLoads` + `FetchChildrenQuery.signal` ONLY when `datasource:is-active` — imperative mode (`setGroupLoading`) keeps an untracked spinner. Abort (+ release loading) on new definitions — `datasource:data` claim (refetch after sort/filter/`refresh()` → else a stale response refills `groupRowsMap`) or `setGroups()` (else the dedupe guard skips the fresh request) — `setGroupRows`/`clearGroupRows` (cleared keys), detach. Collapse KEEPS the load (rows cached; re-expand while in flight does not re-request). All requests go through `#requestGroupRows`.
- INVARIANT (PR #533): `datasource:data` claim clears `groupRowsMap` but expanded keys SURVIVE — so the claim MUST re-request (`#requestGroupRows`, new definition + `groupPath`) every expanded key that had rows or an in-flight load before the clear and still exists. Snapshot BEFORE the clear. Tests: `grouping-rows-plugin.spec.ts` "(#531)", `integration/server-side-child-requests.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (#534): expansion paths that bypass `toggle()` (`defaultExpanded` applied mid-render in `#preDefinedNodes`, `expandAll()`, `expand()`) fetch via a Tree-style reconcile: `endHierarchy` (predefined mode) flags a rendered expanded group with no rows / not loading / not in `#requestedKeys` → `#queueGroupRowRequests` microtask → `#requestExpandedGroupRows` (ServerSide active only; parent groups with `children` skipped; rechecks EVERY key of `getGroupPath` ∈ `expandedKeys` — `item.expanded` is stale if `collapse*()` ran before the flush; skipped keys stay unmarked, PR #537). `#requestedKeys` = ONE automatic attempt per key, marked by EVERY `#requestGroupRows` call (also marked when skipped/imperative → `is-active` queried once); cleared on new definitions (claim, `setGroups`, detach) → a failed group retries once per refetch. Manual collapsed→expanded (`toggle()` requests directly; `expand()`/`expandAll()` delete the key from `#requestedKeys`) = fresh attempt (retry after error). WHY: side effects out of the render pipeline; one hook covers every expand path. Model-visible groups only, NOT viewport-limited (Tree parity). Tests: `grouping-rows-plugin.spec.ts` "(#534)".
- TENSION (#538): the claim treats EVERY ServerSide block as the full definition set (`preDefinedGroups = d.rows`, ignores `startNode`) and purges `groupRowsMap`/loads per block; `#preDefinedNodes` drops ServerSide's placeholders and `getTopLevelGroupIndex` clamps the mapping to loaded groups → groups past block 0 are replaced (with `loadThreshold`) or never requested. Needs append-vs-purge signal on `DataSourceDataDetail`.

- DECIDED (#504): reuse the pure flat builders (`buildGroupedRowModel` + `keyPrefix`/`context`, `buildPreDefinedGroupModel`) and re-nest their visible flat output into `HierarchyNode`s (`#nest`), recording each row's `RenderRow` in `#renderItems` so `getFlattenedRows()` is identical standalone. Pre-defined mode replaces the ROOT list only. `accordion: boolean | (depth) => boolean`. `defaultExpanded: true` also opens each nested list's new top-level groups (`#seenNestedKeys`).
- DECIDED (#335, deferred expansion): `setGroupOn(fn, expanded?)` takes `DefaultExpandedValue: boolean|number|string|string[]` seeding expansion against the NEW group set on the next rebuild (sets `groupConfigDirty`); `expandAll`/`collapseAll` called right after it ALSO defer via `pendingExpansion`. `beginHierarchy` snapshots+clears `pendingExpansion`, the root list resolves it against fresh `getGroupKeys(initialBuild)`, nested (tree-child) lists resolve it against their OWN top-level keys in `#buildNestedGroups` (additive — every pending path already cleared `expandedKeys`), `endHierarchy` broadcasts `group-toggle` once.
- INVARIANT: bulk `group-toggle` emissions MUST use `broadcast<GroupToggleDetail>`, not `emitPluginEvent`. `GroupToggleDetail.{key,expanded,value,depth}` are optional (bulk carries only `expandedKeys`).
- INVARIANT (PR #506): grouped-column fields / sort directions are resolved in `processSiblings` from the FIRST sibling list whose `groupOn(row, context)` is non-null (`#groupFieldsResolved`), not from the root list — depth-gated `groupOn` (`depth > 0 ? … : null`) groups nested lists only. Directions are keyed by group-path index, so one map serves every list.
